# <Idea> — Market and Competitor Research

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Researcher | agent:chatgpt |
| Date | `<YYYY-MM-DD>` |
| Time spent | `<minutes>` (timebox: 60 min) |
| Feeds | `skills/idea-score` |

Rules: every claim has a source link and access date. Never invent market size, download counts or reviews. If not found, write `NOT FOUND`.

## 1. Problem evidence
| Evidence | Type (search trend, forum post, review, interview) | Link | Date | Strength (weak/medium/strong) |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## 2. Competitors and alternatives
| Name | Link | Platform | Price | Core loop / feature | Strengths | Weaknesses (from reviews, cite) | Last update |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Minimum: 3 direct competitors or a documented statement that fewer exist, plus the non-product alternative (spreadsheet, manual, do nothing).

## 3. Differentiation
What we do that the top 3 do not, in one sentence each. Mark as Assumption unless evidenced.

## 4. Audience reachability
| Channel | Est. reachable testers in 24h | Cost | Evidence | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## 5. Feasibility in 48 hours
Third-party APIs, store review delays, legal/content constraints.

## 6. Risks (legal, safety, privacy, platform policy)
Any serious item → idea-score outcome STOP.

## 7. Summary for idea-score
- Strongest evidence:
- Biggest unknown:
- Recommended screening outcome (GO / VALIDATE_FIRST / REJECT / STOP) with reason:
